chapter.title: Applied Energistics 2
chapter.subtitle: Start with Certus Quartz and follow the chain

quests.title: Certus Quartz
quests.subtitle: AE2's silicon
description: Certus Quartz is the crystal behind AE2. Mine it from white-blue clusters, then grow more by dropping a seed in water.
Next: an Inscriber to make processors.

quests.title: Inscriber
quests.subtitle: The processor machine
description: The Inscriber presses circuits and processors from silicon and press plates. Find press plates in Meteorites.
Next: craft your first Logic Processor.

quests.title: First Processor
quests.subtitle: Logic Processor
description: Press Silicon with a Logic Press, then combine the printed circuit with redstone to make a Logic Processor.
Next: an ME Controller to build your network.

quests.title: ME Controller
quests.subtitle: Brain of the network
description: The ME Controller powers your storage network and provides channels - 32 per face. Connect a Drive and a Terminal to it.
Next: a Storage Cell to hold your items.

quests.title: Storage Cell
quests.subtitle: Store everything digitally
description: A 1k Storage Cell holds 1024 item types in a Drive. Craft it with charged certus quartz and redstone.
This completes Phase 1. Next: Autocrafting Setup.

quests.title: Smart Cable
quests.subtitle: See channel usage
description: Smart Cables show channel usage visually - amber when partial, green when full.

quests.title: Storage Bus
quests.subtitle: Attach external inventories
description: A Storage Bus exposes a chest, barrel, or machine output as part of your ME network.

quests.title: Facade
quests.subtitle: Hide cables
description: Facades hide cables inside matching blocks. Four Cable Anchors plus a block makes four Facades.

quests.title: Autocrafting Setup
quests.subtitle: Craft on demand
description: A Crafting Accelerator plus a Molecular Assembler plus a Pattern Provider enables on-demand crafting from your terminal.
Next: encode Crafting Patterns.

quests.title: Crafting Patterns
quests.subtitle: Teach the network recipes
description: A Crafting Pattern tells the Assembler a workbench recipe. Encode patterns at a Pattern Encoding Terminal.
Next: a Pattern Provider for processing recipes.

quests.title: Pattern Provider
quests.subtitle: Push items to machines
description: A Pattern Provider pushes ingredients to a machine and receives the result. Attach it to a Mekanism or Create machine for automated processing.
Next: large-scale autocrafting.

quests.title: Large Autocrafting
quests.subtitle: Parallel crafting
description: A 64k Crafting Storage plus multiple Co-Processors runs parallel crafting. Request a complex item and watch it cascade.
Next: an ME Interface to bridge your network to the world.

quests.title: ME Interface
quests.subtitle: Bridge to the world
description: An ME Interface lets belts, pipes, and machines push items into and pull items from your network, and keeps a fixed stock.
Next: P2P Tunnels to extend your network.

quests.title: P2P Tunnels
quests.subtitle: Compress channels
description: P2P Tunnels compress 32 channels into one. Link them with a Memory Card to extend your network across your base.
This completes Phase 2. Next: a Quantum Network Bridge.

quests.title: Import Bus
quests.subtitle: Pull items into the network
description: An Import Bus pulls items from a chest or machine into your ME network.

quests.title: Level Emitter
quests.subtitle: Redstone from item counts
description: A Level Emitter emits redstone based on item count. Use it to turn factories on when low and off when full.

quests.title: Matter Condenser
quests.subtitle: Trash into matter
description: A Matter Condenser turns trash into Matter Balls, which become Singularities for the Quantum Bridge.

quests.title: Quantum Network Bridge
quests.subtitle: Cross-dimension networking
description: A Quantum Link Chamber connects two ME networks across any distance or dimension. Link the rings with Entangled Singularities.
Next: Spatial Storage to move entire rooms.

quests.title: Spatial Storage
quests.subtitle: Store entire rooms
description: A Spatial Storage Cell stores entire rooms - blocks, entities, everything - inside a Spatial Pylon ring. Move your factory in one operation.
This completes the AE2 chapter.

quests.title: Wireless Terminal
quests.subtitle: Access your network anywhere
description: A Wireless Terminal accesses your ME network from anywhere in the same dimension.

quests.title: Cell Workbench
quests.subtitle: Partition storage cells
description: A Cell Workbench partitions cells by item type so one item cannot flood all storage.

quests.title: Formation Plane
quests.subtitle: Place and break blocks
description: Formation and Annihilation Planes place and break blocks from your ME network. Use with a Level Emitter to auto-refill materials.
